title: angelica geniculata
intro: Angelica geniculata, commonly known as Wild Angelica or Prairie Angelica, is a perennial plant native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, thanks to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Angelica geniculata include its use as an antispasmodic, antiseptic, and diuretic, which helps to relieve pain, reduce inflammation, and promote urination. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
